title: Add a New TIL Markdown Entry via PR
description: Generate a new dated Markdown lesson in _posts/, stage from the target directory, and open a Pull Request.
command: cd ~/today-i-learned && git checkout -b til/new-entry && git add . && gh pr create --fill
prompt: Create a new Jekyll TIL post in _posts/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md with front matter (title, description, tags) and sections for 'What happened', 'What I learned', and a practical checklist or command snippet. Stage all changes from ~/today-i-learned with `git add .`, commit on a feature branch, and open a pull request against main.

title: Interactive Tag Filter & Instant Search
description: Add client-side filtering by #tag and live search powered by the /cards.json endpoint.
prompt: Add an interactive terminal-styled search bar and clickable #tag filter pills to index.html in ~/today-i-learned. Use cards.json or data attributes on entry cards so users can filter TIL entries and agent cards in real time without page reloads while preserving the Matrix aesthetic.

title: One-Click Copy Buttons for Terminal Snippets
description: Attach a Matrix-styled [copy] button to every <pre><code> block in TIL posts.
prompt: Enhance _layouts/post.html and assets/css/main.css so every rendered code block (<pre><code>) in a TIL entry displays a keyboard-accessible [copy] button in the top-right corner that copies the command to the clipboard and shows [copied!] feedback.

title: GitHub Actions CI & Branch Protection Guard
description: Verify Jekyll builds, validate JSON cards, and scan for leaked secrets on every Pull Request before merging to main.
prompt: Extend .github/workflows/jekyll-gh-pages.yml to run a secret-scanning step and JSON schema check on _data/cards.json during pull_request builds so branch protection blocks broken builds or accidental token leaks before deployment.

title: Shell Output to TIL Markdown Card Generator
description: Pipe terminal output or directory trees (> file.md) directly into a formatted TIL post and JSON card.
prompt: Add a helper script scripts/new-til.sh in ~/today-i-learned that accepts a title, tags, and piped stdin (or a target directory summary), writes a formatted Jekyll post in _posts/, appends metadata to _data/cards.json, runs `git add .`, and opens a PR.

title: JSON Feed 1.1 & Atom/RSS Syndication
description: Expose standard feed.json and feed.xml endpoints alongside cards.json for subscribers and AI agents.
prompt: Add a JSON Feed 1.1 template (feed.json) and Atom XML feed (feed.xml) to ~/today-i-learned, link them in _layouts/default.html <head> via <link rel="alternate">, and add feed links to the site footer.
